'''Cyclossi''' are monsters found inside the [[Warriors' Guild]]. They are much taller than a regular [[cyclops]] and drop the [[dragon defender]] and [[cyclopean helmet]]. There is a chance a cyclossus will be summoned when a player kills a regular cyclops, providing the player had shown a [[Rune defender|rune]] or [[dragon defender]] to [[Kamfreena]] before entering the room and wielded one whilst killing the cyclops. Unlike fighting the cyclops, either type of defender must be wielded while fighting Cyclossus; otherwise, the player will be prevented from doing any damage.

When a cyclossus first appears, it can only be attacked by the player it is after, and nobody else. If the original player breaks off combat with the cyclossus (by not attacking it or being attacked by it for 10 seconds), the cyclossus will walk around the room taunting other players by name, and calling out things like "Your mum has two eyes!" and "Two-eyed freaks! Think you can take on Cyclossus?" During this time, any player not in combat can attack the cyclossus, not just the original player.

The cyclossus possesses a special move which shoves the player back several squares and knocks the player down. The cyclossus then follows this move up with a magic attack that looks like a tiny lightning bolt. This always hits, damaging and stunning the player. This does not act like an actual stun, as the player can still attack and use food during this time. [[Anticipation]] will not block the stun, but [[Freedom]] can be used to clear it. It is recommended to stand near a wall in the warriors guild while fighting Cyclossus, to stop it from pushing you away. This will do two hits; the pushing hit that does not hurt a lot and a lightning bolt that also does minor damage.

The melee attacks of a cyclossus are much more accurate than those of a regular cyclops. The [[Protect from Melee]] prayer blocks some melee damage and is recommended for players who can use that prayer. This prayer, however, does not block the special move or magic attack of the cyclossus. Harrallak does not allow [[Ancient Curses]] to be used in the Warriors' Guild, so [[Deflect Melee]] and [[Soul Split]] cannot be used. Ancient curse users should switch to the regular prayers if they wish to use prayers in the room.
